children: Overview
US mortgage REIT reported Q3 net loss per share of $0.92, reversing prior quarter's profit
Earnings available for distribution per share fell to $0.47 from $0.50 in Q2
Book value per share dropped 16% to $6.74; economic return was negative 11.6%
Outlook
Company maintains constructive outlook for Agency RMBS and Agency CMBS sectors
Company expects Agency RMBS to benefit from increased institutional investor participation
Company sees Agency CMBS as attractive due to elevated yields and diversification benefits
Result Drivers
RATE VOLATILITY - Co said increased interest rate volatility and wider mortgage-backed securities spreads weighed on portfolio returns
NEGATIVE RETURNS - Portfolio produced negative returns relative to Treasuries, partially offset by improved swap spreads
PORTFOLIO SHIFT - Co reduced Agency CMBS allocation and increased Agency RMBS exposure amid wider spreads
